subject: Snapshot retention, deletion SLA & SIG kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcare.com>; Priya Desai <priya.desai@helixcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + asks from today's security discovery call

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and our open asks so we can move this to procurement and legal: 

Summary of items we discussed:
- HelixCare is evaluating Redwood for clinical notes enrichment and anonymized analytics (prod + test).
- HIPAA covered; customer data will be PHI in prod.
- You requested deletion SLAs, snapshot lifecycle info, and evidence for SOC 2 controls relevant to logging and backups.

Open items / asks from HelixCare we need to address:
1) Deletion SLA: HelixCare preference is explicit 30-day deletion for customer data at request (with evidence). Please confirm Redwood's standard timeline and whether we can commit to contractual 30-day erase plus attestation.
2) Snapshot retention: Clarify backup/snapshot TTLs for both primary data and KV caches. You mentioned wanting a maximum snapshot retention of 90 days, but also asked about cold storage backups.
3) Logs + backups: Clarify how long raw request logs and structured audit logs are retained (separately), where backups are stored, and whether backup copies are encrypted with a customer-managed key (BYOK).
4) SOC 2 + questionnaire: HelixCare will send a SIG-lite / vendor security questionnaire. They asked for a SOC 2 Type II report or a summary of controls relevant to data erasure, backup protection, and incident response.

Actions from our side (next):
- I will attach a concise retention matrix and a SOC 2 summary for the controls they asked about.
- Ben, can you confirm RPO/RTO for snapshot restores and whether we can provide deletion evidence (audit log + restore test) within a contractable SLA?

Samir — if you could share the SIG-lite PDF and the preferred legal contact for the addendum that would help us align on timelines. Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Week 0: Share SOC 2 summary + retention matrix (Redwood) — TODAY
- Week 1: HelixCare returns SIG-lite + questionnaire answers; legal comment on deletion clause
- Week 2: Agree on deletion SLA and snapshot TTL; draft addendum and sign via DocuSign

Attachments: redwood-retention-matrix.xlsx (high-level), redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf (controls summary).

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute follow-up to walk through specifics.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcare.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's security discovery call

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap. Priya and I confirmed the SIG-lite (attached) and our legal lead Amit Rao (copied) will be the point for contract language. A few clarifications from our end: 

- Deletion SLA: 30 days is a hard requirement for prod PHI datasets; we'll need an attested process and a sample audit extract showing deletion timestamps.
- Snapshots: We are OK with 90 days for snapshots if Redwood can guarantee immutable snapshots for at least 30 days and provide a snapshot inventory on request. Cold storage backups can be longer but need to be flagged and accessible only by ops with MFA.
- Encryption: BYOK for backups is preferred but not mandatory for initial POC; we want to know if the option exists and how long key rotation events are recorded.

We've attached HelixCare-SIG-initial.pdf with a few focused questions. Amit — can you confirm the legal timeline? We are targeting an internal procurement window of 3 weeks.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
VP Product
HelixCare

Attachment: HelixCare-SIG-initial.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helixcare.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@helixcare.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + asks from today's security discovery call

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks — answered inline below and attached the retention matrix as promised.

1) Deletion SLA: Redwood standard is 90 days for full deletion workflow by default (to account for backups and cross-region replication). We can offer a contract addendum for a 30-day deletion commitment for customer data in prod environments, with the following caveats: deletion evidence consists of (a) deletion job log entries, (b) backup manifest showing no copies older than TTL, and (c) a verification snapshot we can supply within 7 business days. We can include these artifacts as part of the attestation package.

2) Snapshots/TTL: Primary snapshots are retained for 90 days by default; cold backups are kept 365 days unless the customer opts for a shorter retention window. We support immutable snapshots for the first 30 days after creation. Snapshot inventory can be exported on request (CSV).

3) Logs vs structured audit trails:
- Raw request logs: 60 days by default (rotated to cold archive thereafter).
- Structured audit logs (access, admin actions): retained 365 days and available for eDiscovery exports.

4) BYOK: Supported for backups in Private/Dedicated deployments. For Hosted (standard) we offer envelope encryption with customer-managed keys via KMS integrations for enterprise customers. Key rotation events are recorded in the audit log with timestamp and operator id.

Attached: redwood-retention-matrix.xlsx, redwood-soc2-type2-summary.pdf.

Proposed follow-up: Jonas / Marissa to schedule a focused 30-minute call for SLA wording and to share a draft addendum (we can use DocuSign template). If procurement timeline is 3 weeks, we will prioritize this as a fast-track.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
